-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.bbolt.DB__grow` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem bbolt.DB.grow.wp_proof [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (hLogger
    : bbolt.DB.Logger.spec) (hFileSize : bbolt.DB.fileSize.spec) (hGrowSize :
    bbolt.DB.growSize.spec) (hTruncate : os.File.Truncate.spec) (hSync : os.File.Sync.specB)
    (hErrorf : fmt.Errorf.spec) : bbolt.DB.grow.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.DB.grow.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (fr : Bool) (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (v : bbolt.View) (w : bbolt.WDb) (sz : w64),
    0 ≤ sint.Z sz →
      sint.Z sz + 16777216 < 2 ^ 63 →
        sint.Z sz % 4096 = 0 →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              K.core ∗ bbolt.wdbW' fr K tx v w -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ err,
                      (∃ w',
                          bbolt.wdbW' fr K tx v w' ∗
                            ⌜bbolt.wdbGrown w w'⌝ ∗
                              (⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ fmtErrorOk err)) -∗
                        Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.DB.ty.PointerType go!"grow" (intoVal K.db)))
                      (intoVal sz))
                    {{ Φ }}
